# Application permissions

Granted per role, per namespace, per cluster (or all clusters) under **Admin → Roles**. Admins hold all of them. A user's permission is checked on every request, in the namespace of the request.

**Safe read-only** marks the grants of the API access mode of the same name and of the API key template: `list`, `get` and `logs`, except on ConfigMaps and Secrets, whose data can hold credentials.

**Endpoints** come from the API description (`/api/openapi.json`); an endpoint that needs two permissions is listed under both. The Kubernetes rights behind each one are on [Kubernetes permissions](kubernetes-permissions.md).

## Pods

| Permission | Opens | Safe read-only | Endpoints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pods:list` | The resource's Dashboard tab and its list endpoint. | yes | `GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/metrics/pods`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/metrics/pods/{name}`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/pods` |
| `pods:get` | The pod drawer: status, containers, events, restart history, CPU / memory; the YAML view. | yes | `GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}/events`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}/restarts`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}/yaml` |
| `pods:logs` | Pod logs: live, previous container, download, the REST log snapshot. With `deployments:get` / `jobs:get`, the logs of every pod of a Deployment or Job. | yes | `GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}/logs`<br/>`GET /ws/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}/logs` (with `deployments:get`)<br/>`GET /ws/namespaces/{namespace}/jobs/{name}/logs` (with `jobs:get`)<br/>`GET /ws/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}/logs` |
| `pods:exec` | A shell in a container, and one command over the API. Every session is audited; sessions opened with an API key are always recorded. |  | `POST /api/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}/exec`<br/>`GET /ws/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}/exec` |
| `pods:edit` | Edit and apply the YAML, with a server-side dry run first. |  | `POST /api/namespaces/{namespace}/{resource}/{name}/apply` |

## Deployments

| Permission | Opens | Safe read-only | Endpoints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deployments:list` | The resource's Dashboard tab and its list endpoint. | yes | `GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments` |
| `deployments:get` | The Deployment drawer (revisions read only, pods, usage); the YAML view. | yes | `GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}/events`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}/replicasets`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}/restarts`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}/yaml`<br/>`GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/metrics/deployments/{name}`<br/>`GET /ws/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}/logs` (with `pods:logs`) |
| `deployments:restart` | Rolling restart: patches the pod template's `restartedAt` annotation. |  | `POST /api/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}/restart` |
| `deployments:scale` | Change the replica count (0 to `MAX_REPLICAS`). |  | `POST /api/namespaces/{namespace}/deployments/{name}/scale` |
| `deployments:edit` | Edit and apply the YAML, with a server-side dry run first. |  | `POST /api/namespaces/{namespace}/{resource}/{name}/apply` |

## Secrets

| Permission | Opens | Safe read-only | Endpoints |
|---|---|---|---|
| `secrets:list` | The Secrets tab: names, types and key names. Never the values. |  | `GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/secrets` |
| `secrets:get` | One Secret's metadata, key names and value sizes. Never the values. |  | `GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/secrets/{name}` |
| `secrets:reveal` | Show one value of a Secret per request. Each reveal is audited with the key name. |  | `POST /api/namespaces/{namespace}/secrets/{name}/reveal` |
| `secrets:edit` | The Secret YAML editor, which shows every value, and apply. Opening it is audited as `secret.view_yaml`. |  | `GET /api/namespaces/{namespace}/secrets/{name}/yaml`<br/>`POST /api/namespaces/{namespace}/{resource}/{name}/apply` |
